name: Acid Coat, Lesser
body:
School evocation [acid]; Level magus 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5ft./2 levels)
Target one living or undead creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You envelop the target a coat of acid dealing 1d4 acid damage. This reduces the hardness of objects and DR of constructs by 1 for 1 round. A successful Reflex save halves this damage and negates the hardness/DR reduction.
